Ah...! I have to eject...!
Viletta
Time to go...! I'm ejecting.

Blew it...!@Have to bail out...
Excellen
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Kusuha

Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
Arieil
I leave the rest to you...
Duban
To think someone could force me back...!!

Tch!! What an early curtain call!

Kyaaaaah!!

N-Next time... for sure!!

Kyah! I leave the rest to you!

Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
Russel
I'm sorry! I'm bailing out!
Tasuku
Dammit! How pathetic...!!
Leona
How... humiliating...!
Sänger

So I, too, still have much to learn...!
Lefina
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Touma

Yuuki
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Carla
I've got to eject...!
Axel
Ngh!@So this is it...!!

Is this... as far as I go...?
Kota

Shoko
Big brother... Emi... I'm sorry!!
Michiru
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
Ibis
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Sleigh
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Raul
This... This can't be happening...!
Fiona
I-I'm beaten?! No way!

Oh no, it can't be!

Th-This is my limit!!

Radha

Masaki

Lüne
I'm sorry, Valsione...!
Shu
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Amala
It can't be helped... Withdrawing!
Albada
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
Serena
N-No way!!
Haken
Guess I blew it...!
Akimi

Akemi
I-Is this the end?!
Vort
I can't keep fighting...!!
Sieg
Sally
I have no choice but to eject...!
Touya
N-Not here!!
Calvina
How disgraceful...!!
E-Selda
Curses...!!
Al-Van
I let my guard down...!
Skull Knight
Aw, man, they got me good!
Return face to default
L1 Space
Steel Dragons
Aboard the Hagane
So, what happened?
Lieutenant Irm got permission from the top,@saying he needed to pull its combat data@on the unknowns, but...
It booted up in maintenance mode,@but it wouldn't do a normal startup.
Not even for former Lieutenant Calvina?
Nope. No matter how many times she tried.
Then maybe it's not biometric authentication.
Some kind of security mode,@or maybe a sort of lockdown mode...
That girl... Was Tenia there?
No.
Could it be that it won't start@unless she's riding with her?
Yeah, we came to the same conclusion.@Seems former Lieutenant Calvina had a hunch too...
So did you try it with the girl aboard?
Well, about that...
Oh, don't tell me the commander said no?
Bingo. No civilians... let alone a child...@allowed in the combat section, he says.
He's not wrong, but...
Well, if you think about Tenia, anyway.
But if it won't start without two people aboard...@That's fine for a <Choukijin> like RyuKoOh,@but isn't it a big flaw for a mobile weapon?
Only if they plan to mass-produce it later.@But the Bellzelute carries a new kind of@man-machine interface, the Cytron System...
and an Orgon Extractor power source, so it@seems to be a test unit. Maybe it needed both@a pilot and a system operator.
Then what about the two-person startup condition?
Could be a kind of security@peculiar to test units.
By the way, where's Tenia?
Aya and Mai are looking after her right now.
Hagane: Mess Hall
Hey, Tenia, what's your favorite food?
Tenia
Hmm... There's too many, I can't pick just one.
Then what don't you like?
Nothing. I eat everything.
Then Mai should learn from you.
What don't you like?
...Natto...
Huh? But it's tasty. You're just like my dad.@He loves Japanese food, but natto...
Tenia?
Dad...@That day, he said after the Bellzelute test,@we'd go with Mom to a great Japanese restaurant...
Tenia, have you eaten yet?
No, not yet...
Then after you're done is fine.@Could you come with me for a bit?
Huh?
Calvina, you're not thinking of...
Tetsuya
Attention all hands.@Unidentified mobile weapons confirmed at Range 4.@Level 1 battle stations to intercept. Repeat...
Tenia, you stay here.
O-Okay.
You too, Calvina. Please behave yourself.
I think I am, actually.
...Mai, let's go!
Got it!
(Unidentified mobile weapons... Maybe...)
Tenia... Don't you want to know?
Huh? Know what?
The truth about That Incident.
If you want to know, follow me.
But there's a soldier on guard.
Let me show you why they called me@Lynx... the wildcat.
Eita
Targets still closing!@10 seconds until they enter Range 2!
XO, intercept with the forward secondary guns@and the VLS Missile Launchers.
Roger! Forward secondary guns, 1 through 4!@Upper port and starboard VLS Missile Launchers,@prepare to fire!
Targets in range!
Fire!
Azuki
SRX Team, PTX Team, launch in order!
So the new guys dodged with every unit, huh?
Because they're new models with high specs?@Or is it the pilots' skill?
Before that... Are they really new <Zovorg> units?@They seem to be from a different line...
Their nation's gotta have lots of manufacturers.@No surprise if some units look a little different.
Squire
So that's the <Steel Dragons>,@who sealed away Vaula...!
Don't push forward chasing glory.@We only need to hold them off while@Lady Fu-Ruu scouts the Gate of Voda.
But you must not suffer the shame of capture.@We need to keep our identity hidden@a while longer.
Yes, ma'am!
Spiria 0 to all units!@Spread out and intercept the enemy!
Roger! Let's go, everyone!
You got it!
...The ones in those new models@don't seem to be Bioroids.
Yeah. They don't move with that weird feel@those things have.
Humans piloting Zovorg mass-production units...@That's a rare case.
(Plenty about this is suspicious.@Maybe we should capture one of the new models...?)
Gravity quake reaction at 12 o'clock! Five of them!
Enemy reinforcements!?
No matching <ES Wave Pattern>!@They'll transfer out any moment!
Fu-Ruu
My, my...@Just as I thought, the Steel Dragons@are no easy opponents.
Th-That one, the color's different, but...!
Same type as the one from That Time!@Hurry, Tenia!
But where are we...@Oh, wait, you mean the Bellzelute?!
Of course! I won't let this lead slip away!
...That counterfeit hasn't come out.@It should be aboard the Hagane, though.
Lady Fu-Ruu, why have you come here...?!
This is too much for Squires like you.@Fall back.
B-But, Lady Fu-Ruu,@you were headed for the Gate of Voda...
If the Steel Dragons have come out, that changes@things. Now, all of you, head for the Orgo@Transfer Base's transfer exit point.
Al-Van should be arriving soon.@Join up with him.
Y-Yes, sir!
She sent her allies back...?
If they're Zovorg, they'd know about us.@Looks like she's pretty confident.
(The red mothership... and no sign of the "Key" either.@Then again, we're without a "Key"@ourselves at the moment...)
Spiria 0 to all units.@Reaching Cross Gate Space is our priority.@Focus fire on the new model and break past the Hagane.
(To be honest, as a knight,@I've wanted to cross swords with them once.)
(The power that sealed Vaula...@I shall see it for myself.)
...What?@No, I haven't authorized a sortie.@...Yes, we'll call to them from here as well.
Miles
What is it, XO?
It seems Calvina Coulange and@Festenia Muse have boarded the Bellzelute@and intend to launch.
What?! They mean to flee in this situation?!
I'd think it's more dangerous outside the ship.
Hmph, letting civilians do as they please...!@This ship still has slack in it, I see.
...My apologies.
Get the civilians out of that unit and detain them.@This is an emergency. You may use force.
Understood. Detaining the two civilians.@As peacefully as possible, and quickly.
Good. That's the best answer.
Azuki, put me through to the Bellzelute.
Roger, connecting!
This is Executive Officer Tetsuya Onodera.@Respond, former Lieutenant Calvina Coulange.
...Ah, good timing.@We're launching. Open the hatch.
Launching...?
This ship is in combat. I can't allow it.@Get out of that unit immediately.
This Bellzelute isn't yours.@How I use it is my business.
What do you plan to do once you leave the ship?
That green new model... It's the same type@as the one that attacked Ashurey Kreuzer.
Which makes it a lead on my enemy.@I'm not letting it go.
XO, this is no place for a civilian.@She is currently under my unit's jurisdiction.
If she will not obey our orders,@detain her by force.
Commander, may I offer my opinion?
What's that?
Let's launch the Bellzelute.@It may give us a clue to the enemy's identity@and objective.
What nonsense!@Calvina Coulange is no longer@a soldier!
True, but she used to be an ace.@What's more, our unit has a track record@of joint operations with civilians.
That was before I took command!@Besides, enlisting civilians in military operations@is a serious problem in itself!
What's more, she and the Bellzelute are@a key witness and evidence in the@Ashurey Kreuzer attack!
If we launch it, the enemy may react somehow.@Right now, I believe we need any clue we can get@about the enemy's identity and objective.
I judge this to be the most peaceful and swift@way to handle this situation.
That is hardly the best answer...!
Could you open the hatch already?@Otherwise I'll have to get rough.@Not that I want to.
Are you threatening us?! That's a crime!
...Calvina, are you serious?
It's a bluff. More importantly, do a normal startup@on the Bellzelute. You can do that, right?
Yeah.@Starting the ignition sequence.
As long as I'm commander, I won't allow such an outrage!
Bellzelute, start up!
Wh-Why, the insolence!
Commander,@at this rate the hangar may be damaged.@Is that acceptable?
You... You intend to side with the XO?
(Captain...)
I merely judged so as the one entrusted with this ship.@If we avoid damage, there will be ways to explain.
Ngh...
You may report it as my own decision after the fact.
I don't intend to dodge responsibility that way...@It can't be helped. Launch the Bellzelute.
Roger.
Bellzelute...!
Cytron linkage rate within tolerance.@System all green. We're good to go, Calvina.
(So it really won't move unless Tenia's aboard...)
Is that Calvina?
Yes, of course.
(Can't believe that stiff let her launch.)
Calvina Coulange,@we don't need your help. Go back.
I'm not here to help you.@My goal is to catch that green new model.@It's a lead on my enemy.
What...?
That unit's the same type as the one that wiped@out Ashurey Kreuzer. I won't let it get away.@I'll run it down with this Bellzelute.
But that unit shouldn't move with@former Lieutenant Calvina alone...!
Don't tell me Tenia's in there too?!
Yep, that's right.
Calvina, you...!
Don't get the wrong idea.@I didn't force her aboard.
Right, I'm riding this of my own free will.@To learn the truth about That Incident and avenge@my mom and dad and the others...!
Tenia...
Just as I thought, the Bellzelute@was aboard the Hagane.
Counterfeit or not, leaving it in the Steel Dragons'@hands would be unwise...
I shall dispose of it here myself.
She's after the Bellzelute...?!
(She has a reason to target it too...?)
Tenia, I know you can use the Cytron System,@but just don't get in my way.
Don't put it like that... I can help too!
You're just a key, to make this unit move.@Leave the fighting to me.
The enemy's new model is after the Bellzelute.@Units nearby, give it cover.
...Al-Van should be contacting me@by now. Is he having trouble?
This is...!
Detecting powerful neutron, heavy ion, and gamma rays!@They seem to be coming from the <Cross Gate>!
What!?
And the values are close to the observation@data from the final battle with the <Ruina>!
Don't tell me they're about to come out of the Gate?!
Wh-What's going on?!
Put the Cross Gate on the main screen.@Sergeant Major Azuki, contact the watch fleet.
R-roger!
Telescopic image of the Cross Gate, coming up!
Wh-What... What's happening...?!
Just what was it that rained down on Earth...?!
Use <MOSS> and the Satellite Link@to investigate the situation.
We've been trying to access them since that@phenomenon, but can't connect! And now the radar@and sensors have stopped working properly!
It's as if we'd been hit by powerful <EA>...
Wha...!
Sergeant Major Azuki, any word from the watch fleet?
None! We can't communicate with anyone else either!
(Similar to <Ruina's Dimensional Rift>...@No, at least we can still see Earth.)
To think the Gate of Voda would open so soon...!@The situation is graver than I thought.
In that case, I too must...
You're not getting away!
Wait, Calvina!
Leave me alone!
Calm down, would you?@Charge off in this situation and you'll lose@not just her, but your way back too.
Besides, she's not the only enemy. You need resupply.@One unit alone can't do a thing.@The usual you would see that right away, wouldn't you?
(She came after the Bellzelute.@As long as I'm in this, I'll get another chance...)
You! Who are you people?!@Why did you attack Ashurey Kreuzer?!
(You seem to have the devil's own luck.@But will it hold against me?)
Now then, is she a new Zovorg model, or...
(As a knight of the Fury,@I've awaited the chance to fight you.)
I still can't see any link to the Zovorg units@we've encountered so far. That one especially...
(The finest force in all the Earth military...@Now, show me everything you have.)
(Something feels off...@Are they not Zovorg?)
(We know you quite well, you see.)
I'm with Ryoto on this!@That outline sure ain't Zovorg!
(Allow me to show you@the power of the Raftclans Fauneia.)
Hagane: Bridge
...Still no connection to the Joint Chiefs of Staff?
Yes...
Commander, <MOSS> is coming back online.@Still no sign of explosions near the <Cross Gate>,@the moon, or the L4 area.
So the watch fleet is safe.@But Earth, where that shower of light fell...
No visible abnormalities either.
But after something like that?@I can't believe it had no effect on Earth at all.
(I thought something like that might happen@one day... but with so little warning...)
Commander, we've made contact with the Joint Chiefs!
Oh, put them through.
Daniel
Daniel Howell here.@Brigadier General Miles, it seems you're all safe too.
Then the Cross Gate Watch Fleet is too?
Yes, it's intact.@I'd like you to rendezvous with them.
I hear the Cross Gate has gone silent@since that light phenomenon... but there's no@telling what will happen next.
Sir. This ship will hurry to Cross Gate Space@and join the watch fleet.
Now then, let's hear your report...
So Earth is all right...?
Yeah. Eita on the bridge just secretly@sent me a message on my <D-Con>.
He says there were widespread comms and network@outages, but no major damage.
Considering it started at the Cross Gate,@I doubt that's the end of it.
Still, it's better than something@like the <Ruina> showing up, right?
I agree with Rai.@There's no guarantee that was the end of it.
So is the Gate open right now?@Or is it closed?
From the outside,@it always looks open, but...
After <The Sealing War>, unmanned recon drones@were sent into the Cross Gate several times,@and every one of them vanished.
But if drones can get to the other side...@then it's open, right?
In the end, the only ones who ever came back out@were us, after we beat the <Adamatron>.
For now, yes.
Maybe one of these days they'll order us@to go into the Cross Gate.
...I don't want that.@It feels awful in there... Malice swirls inside.
Like Ryusei said, there's a good chance we'll be@ordered to investigate the cause of that light.@We'd best be prepared.
I'm the one who said it, but gimme a break.
Wh-What did you say...?!@You're reinstating@Calvina Coulange?
That's right.@Deploy her and the Bellzelute with the Steel Dragons.@Along with the civilian who rides with her.
(To think my suggestion would become reality...)
B-But...
Both Calvina Coulange and the civilian girl@boarded the Bellzelute@of their own free will, did they not?
...That's correct.
Entering the combat section, seizing a unit under@military control, launching without permission...@All of it will be overlooked.
Also, this was decided just now by@Field Marshal Gaspard Gilan, who was behind me@listening to your report.
Someone in charge will contact you@later about the formal procedures.
Why would the Field Marshal concern himself@with a mere lieutenant...
Must I explain the details?
N-No, sir. We will deploy Lieutenant@Calvina Coulange and the Bellzelute with our unit...
...and record the unknowns' reactions.
Good. That is all.
You heard him, Captain. Propose a formation.
Then how about placing her with the PTX Team,@who first made contact with her?
Good.
(Looks like she's been stuck with the role of bait...)
Hagane - Briefing Room
...So that's how it is.@The PTX Team is taking in a new recruit.
You look like you want me to introduce myself,@Lieutenant.
Not just your position, your attitude's@changed too, huh.
Who'd have thought it'd be decided by the@ultimate top-down order...
I bet the commander was surprised too.
An order from the Field Marshal himself...@I'm honored beyond words.
Lieutenant Calvina,@that may be fine for you, but@do you need to drag Tenia into this?
You know very well, Captain.@The Bellzelute won't start unless Tenia's aboard.
Even so...
It's okay.
Not because Calvina told me to...@I decided I want to ride it myself.
Because I want to ride the Bellzelute@and avenge Mom and Dad, and Katia and the others.
Then, Tenia,@you'll help me with the Bellzelute's maintenance.@So we can survive and achieve our goal.
...Okay.
(Good. The Bellzelute's parts are all in place.)
(Now... I just keep fighting.)
